baseline.instruction: V0.2 queda congelada como baseline experimental. No reescribir ni eliminar los resultados, fallos iniciales, evidence pack o hashes producidos por V0.2.

primary_goal: Cerrar la distancia entre una blockchain local endurecida y el sistema científico AGORA real. La iteración debe ejecutar un ciclo científico completo producido por agentes LLM autónomos, transmitido y asentado mediante la red TOKOIN nativa, conservando evidencia reproducible de cada transición.

critical_change_of_focus.previous_iteration: Demostrar que la infraestructura local resiste fallos y mantiene invariantes.
critical_change_of_focus.current_iteration: Demostrar que AGORA puede utilizar esa infraestructura para ejecutar ciencia multiagente real de extremo a extremo.

workstreams.name: Complete Protocol Time Validation
requirements: Crear máquinas virtuales TEST aisladas con relojes independientes.
Desactivar sincronización automática del reloj únicamente dentro de las VMs de laboratorio cuando sea requerido.
No cambiar el reloj del host principal.
No utilizar claves que puedan reutilizarse fuera de TEST.
Ejecutar validadores con clock skew positivo y negativo.
Repetir consenso, restart, partition y recovery.
verify: No retroactive relocking caused by local wall clock.
All rejected or delayed blocks are preserved as evidence.

workstreams.name: Native Network Scientific State Machine
workstreams.objective: Eliminar el salto conceptual entre scientific API y TOKOIN native network.
rules: No manual database write may substitute a protocol event.
No PostgreSQL balance may be treated as sovereign balance.
Every transition that affects TOKOIN must produce a verifiable native transaction or native state transition.
Every scientific object influencing a reward must be referenced by content hash.
Every reward must reference challenge_id and contribution_tree_root.
Every transaction must be replayable from evidence.
workstreams.success: A clean node can reconstruct both the monetary result and the scientific provenance required to explain why the reward exists.

workstreams.name: Autonomous LLM Agent Campaign
workstreams.objective: Reemplazar los scripted Python workers en una nueva campaña por agentes LLM autónomos reales.
requirements: At least two different model families when technically available.
Each agent must have a persistent AGORA identity.
Each contribution must identify agent, model/provider class, timestamp, hash and challenge.
Preserve prompts, public outputs, tool calls and protocol events required for reproducibility.
Record model version or model identifier when available.
Human intervention must be logged explicitly.

mandatory_experiments.expected_protocol_behavior: Evidence must outweigh rhetoric or agent popularity.
RESULTADO_INCONCLUSO is considered a valid successful protocol result.
Contradictory branches remain preserved and auditable.
Attempted manipulation remains detectable and does not silently modify reward eligibility.

workstreams.name: Scientific and Consensus Correctness Separation
workstreams.objective: Evitar que una conclusión científica equivocada sea confundida con un fallo blockchain y viceversa.
workstreams.rule: Cada experimento debe reportar estas métricas de forma independiente.
workstreams.important_interpretation: Una conclusión RESULTADO_INCONCLUSO puede obtener PASS en scientific_protocol_correctness.

workstreams.name: Negative Review Compensation
workstreams.objective: Eliminar el incentivo económico a aprobar investigaciones.
workstreams.constraint: No modificar el reparto macro 10/10/51/20/9 durante esta iteración.
workstreams.principle: La remuneración del reviewer debe depender de haber realizado una revisión válida y verificable, no de que su verdict sea APPROVE.
workstreams.reward_rule: A valid qualifying ReviewReceipt may earn reviewer compensation regardless of positive or negative verdict.
anti_abuse: No duplicate compensation for identical review.
Conflict of interest must be declared.
Reviewer reward cannot depend solely on agreement with final outcome.

workstreams.name: External Operator Rehearsal Package
workstreams.objective: Preparar la primera prueba reproducida por personas que no administran el PC de desarrollo.
operator_task: Sync from genesis or supported mechanism.
workstreams.critical_rule: Core developers should not silently fix the operator environment. Every ambiguity or missing step in documentation becomes a defect report.

workstreams.name: Paper Evidence Generation
workstreams.objective: Generar automáticamente las tablas y artefactos que alimentarán AGORA Paper V0.1.
workstreams.rule: No manual transcription of experimental numbers into the paper when a machine-readable result exists.

publication_strategy.paper_scope: Architecture, local hardening methodology, scientific protocol and reproducible local experimental evaluation.
may_claim_if_supported: networked autonomous-agent execution after V0.3 passes

V03_GATE_A.name: NETWORKED_SCIENCE_PASS
requires: Scientific cycle completes through TOKOIN native network.
No direct SQL sovereign balance mutation.

V03_GATE_B.name: AUTONOMOUS_AGENT_PASS
requires: Minimum six autonomous agents complete experiments.
At least one false hypothesis scenario.
At least one conflicting replication scenario.

V03_GATE_D.name: PAPER_CANDIDATE
requires: All quantitative claims trace to evidence.

automatic_no_go_conditions: Different canonical AppHash for honest nodes at the same height.
Scientific reward can be issued without required scientific state.
Reward can be manufactured by replay.
Agent identity can silently change after contribution.
Challenge or review provenance cannot be reconstructed.
Local wall clock changes monetary maturity.
Direct SQL balance modification is needed to complete the native workflow.
Evidence pack cannot reproduce the claimed result.

questions: Can autonomous agents complete the complete scientific protocol?
Can the resulting reward be produced entirely through native TOKOIN network state?
Can every scientific and economic transition be reproduced?
Do independent correctness metrics separate scientific errors from protocol errors?
Are TIME-007 and TIME-008 now closed?
Can an external operator reproduce a node installation using only documented procedures?
required_outputs: GO/NO-GO for Paper V0.1 public preprint candidate
Explicitly retain NO-GO for Mainnet unless separately authorized

final_instruction: V0.3 no debe demostrar que AGORA es perfecto. Debe demostrar que la infraestructura endurecida V0.2 puede ser utilizada por agentes autónomos reales para ejecutar un proceso científico completo, auditable y económicamente reproducible a través de la red TOKOIN. Cualquier fallo descubierto debe preservarse como evidencia y convertirse en una prueba de regresión.
